title: Underwriting Rule: Number of Towing and Labor Coverages per Vehicle and per Named Insured
content:
**Rule.** A named insured may carry **Towing and Labor Coverage** on any number of scheduled vehicles; there is no limit on the number of coverages per named insured. A vehicle carries at most 1 towing coverage per owner term. This holds on every Cardinal Point Towing and Labor package ($50 through $200).

## Basis of the one-per-vehicle limit

- **What is compared.** The limit is judged on the company's own records, before the coverage is added, for the same owner term and the same vehicle (its VIN) as the coverage being added.
- **Which existing coverages count.** An existing towing coverage on that owner term and that vehicle counts when its status is **scheduled**, **active** or **terminated**. A coverage that was **removed**, or that has **expired**, does not count toward the limit.

| Maximum | Figure |
|---|---|
| Towing coverages per named insured | No limit |
| Towing coverages per vehicle per owner term | 1 |

## Judgement table

| Existing towing coverage on the company's records | Same owner term | Same vehicle (VIN) | The one-per-vehicle limit is reached |
|---|---|---|---|
| Scheduled | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Active | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Terminated | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Removed | Yes | Yes | No |
| Any status | Yes | No (another vehicle) | No |
| Any status | No (another owner term) | Yes | No |
| None | — | — | No |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A named insured has three vehicles scheduled on one owner term and wants towing and labor on each. Each vehicle may carry its own coverage; the number of vehicles does not matter.
- A vehicle's towing coverage on the current owner term was removed at the named insured's request; that removed coverage does not count, so the one-per-vehicle limit does not stand in the way of a new towing coverage on the same vehicle and owner term.
- A vehicle already has an active towing coverage on the owner term; the limit of 1 is reached and a second towing coverage is not added to that vehicle for that owner term.
